page.title: Fee policies
page.subtitle: Platform fee, owner commission, booking hold, insurance and tax — versioned, frozen onto each order at creation.
page.activateConfirmTitle: Activate this version? The current active version will be archived.

page.archivedHint: Archived versions are kept only to reconcile past bookings — new bookings use the active policy: {name} (version {version}).
page.archivedHintNoActive: Archived versions are kept only to reconcile past bookings.
page.emptyActive: No policy is active yet — create or activate a draft.
page.emptyArchived: No version has been archived yet.

detail.title: {name} — version {version}
detail.legacyHint: The current money flow does not read these figures; they are kept only to reconcile older orders.

form.name: Name
form.platformFeeHint: A fixed amount per order, paid by the customer, on both tracks — independent of rental length.
form.commissionHint: Deducted from the owner's payout. Each rental day uses the % of the tier it falls in.
form.previewTitle: Example: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} × {daily}
form.previewInvalid: Fix the tiers to see an example.
form.depositHint: Reservation payment = platform fee + commission + insurance + the owner's share. The owner's share is a % of the rental (excluding the delivery fee); on a late cancellation or no-show the owner receives all of it.
form.depositPercent: Owner's share (% of the rental, excluding delivery fee)
form.insuranceHint: Customers only see insurance options once a real insurance partner is in place.
form.insuranceProductHint: Optional for the customer, charged per day.
form.insurancePartnerNameHint: The real partner's name — required when any insurance is on.
form.taxEnabled: Withhold and remit tax on behalf of owners
form.taxEnabledHint: Under Decree 117/2025/ND-CP the platform withholds and remits VAT and PIT for household and individual sellers. Turn on only once a tax adviser has confirmed the classification. Tax is computed on the rental amount, excluding the delivery fee; each tax is exact to the dong.

validation.limitOrder: The maximum must be greater than the minimum
validation.suggestedInRange: The suggested rate must be within the wage-per-day range

form.taxLegalBasisHint: The legal reference for the withholding — shown to owners and printed on the tax ledger.
form.taxScope: Applies to: individuals, household businesses · Companies: not withheld
form.taxScopeValue: Individuals, household businesses · Verified companies: not withheld
form.withDriverLimitsHint: Blocks unreasonable numbers (a missing or extra zero) — not price control. Applies to a vehicle's with-driver daily price and the driver wage per day shops record.
form.driverWageSuggestedHint: Only a market reminder for shops that haven't set a rate — never written into a shop or a trip.

commissionScope.title: Applies to: individual owners (commission track). Package vehicles / shops: exempt (H = 0).
commissionScope.hint: Applies only to individual vehicles (commission track). Shops on a package (package vehicles) are 100% exempt from per-trip commission (H = 0).
